description:
We are Team Ultron, on a mission to inspire the next generation of space explorers.

Our team consists of Arifa Rahman Sikder, our visionary Team Leader.

Joining her, we have Supta Baul, our creative UI/UX Designer; Md. Naimur Rahman, our enthusiastic Researcher; and Abrar Yeasir Adib, our dedicated Game Developer.

Together, we move forward with a simple goal:

Don't just teach the next generation about space exploration. Give them the chance to practice being the people who will do it.
